text:
maria: Quick question — UX for the automatic fallback 'switchback' control. Do we want a single affordance to 'revert to primary' after an autofallback, or a small timeline slider to pick the rollback point?

alex: Single button + cooldown seems simplest. slider adds complexity and storage for payload diffs.

jamal: agree on button, but we need clear signal about why fallback happened (error vs degraded quality). Otherwise SREs will spam it.

sophie: +1. Also, can we show the triggering metric and sample requests that caused the switch? even 1-3 examples would help.

maria: good call. proposal: button labelled "Reinstate primary (cooldown: 10m)", with a small tooltip listing trigger reason + link to audit view. Thoughts on default cooldown? 5m vs 10m?

kevin: i'd default to 10m. too short and we get flapping. also we should expose an opt-in checkbox to run an automated 'switchback after stability' trial (i.e., if primary healthy for N requests, auto-reinstate).

alex: hmm auto-reinstate is neat but we need to avoid oscillation. suggest requiring both timeout + a stability window: e.g. 10m cooldown AND 5m of successful p95 latency under threshold.

jamal: telemetry implications: we don't need full traffic logs for every switch. sampling is fine. propose sample rate 5% for debug traces, 0.1% for full request bodies, but keep aggregated metrics always.

sophie: UI mock: show compact card: status (fallback -> primary), trigger reason badge (error/quality/quota), last 3 samples (redacted), and buttons: [Reinstate now] [Schedule reinstate] [Open audit].

maria: here's a quick config snippet we could surface in the console advanced pane:```json
{
  "autoFallback": true,
  "switchbackCooldownSeconds": 600,
  "autoReinstate": {
    "enabled": false,
    "successWindowSeconds": 300,
    "requiredSuccessRate": 0.95
  },
  "auditSampling": 0.05
}
```

kevin: looks good. For auditSampling let's default to 0.01 for production and allow project override. need retention policy note in UI.

alex: backend note — we'll need a lightweight trace id attached to sampled requests so audit view can fetch the minimal context without storing bodies. keep bodies only when sample flag true.

deploy-bot: Deployment queued: feature/rollouts/switchback-ui -> staging (diff: +34 -7). ETA 12m. :rocket:

maria: next steps: alex + jamal to spec events/telemetry, sophie to mock compact card, kevin to propose sane defaults for sampling/retention. I'll gather and iterate on wording for the button/tooltips. Thanks! :thumbsup:
